test_vqvae_construction: test constructing VectorQuantizer and VectorQuantizerEMA modules with embedding_dim, num_embeddings, and commitment_cost parameters
test_vqvae_shape_checking: test that VectorQuantizer and VectorQuantizerEMA raise InvalidArgumentError when given inputs with wrong shape
